verses.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
verses.pt: E toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel se juntou em Siló, e assentaram ali o tabernáculo do testemunho, depois que a terra lhes foi sujeita.
verses.en_web: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.
verses.en_bbe: And all the meeting of the children of Israel came together at Shiloh and put up the Tent of meeting there: and the land was crushed before them.

verses.en: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.pt: Mas haviam restado nos filhos de Israel sete tribos, às quais ainda não haviam repartido sua possessão.
verses.en_web: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: But there were still seven tribes among the children of Israel who had not taken up their heritage.

verses.en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?
verses.pt: E Josué disse aos filhos de Israel: Até quando sereis negligentes para vir a possuir a terra que vos deu o SENHOR o Deus de vossos pais?
verses.en_web: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you?
verses.en_bbe: Then Joshua said to the children of Israel, Why are you so slow to go in and take up your heritage in the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, has given you?

verses.en: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
verses.pt: Assinalai três homens de cada tribo, para que eu os envie, e que eles se levantem, e percorram a terra, e a descrevam conforme suas propriedades, e se voltem a mim.
verses.en_web: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; and they shall come to me.
verses.en_bbe: Take from among you three men from every tribe; and I will send them to go through the land and make a record of it for distribution as their heritage; then let them come back to me.

verses.en: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
verses.pt: E a dividirão em sete partes: e Judá estará em seu termo ao sul, e os da casa de José estarão no seu ao norte.
verses.en_web: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.
verses.en_bbe: And let them make division of it into seven parts: let Judah keep inside his limit on the south, and let the children of Joseph keep inside their limit on the north.

verses.en: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
verses.pt: Vós, pois, demarcareis a terra em sete partes, e me trareis a descrição aqui, e eu vos lançarei as sortes aqui diante do SENHOR nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to have the land marked out in seven parts, and come back to me with the record; and I will make the distribution for you here by the decision of the Lord our God.

verses.en: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.
verses.pt: Porém os levitas nenhuma parte têm entre vós; porque o sacerdócio do SENHOR é a herança deles: Gade também e Rúben, e a meia tribo de Manassés, já receberam sua herança da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente, a qual lhes deu Moisés servo do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Yahweh is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them.”
verses.en_bbe: For the Levites have no part among you; to be the Lord's priests is their heritage; and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have had their heritage on the east side of Jordan, given to them by Moses, the servant of the Lord.

verses.en: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.
verses.pt: Então aqueles homens se levantaram e se foram; e Josué deu ordem aos que iam demarcar a terra, dizendo-lhes: Ide, percorrei a terra, e demarcai-a, e voltai a mim, para que eu vos lance as sortes aqui diante do SENHOR em Siló.
verses.en_web: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh in Shiloh.”
verses.en_bbe: So the men got up and went; and Joshua gave orders to those who went, to make a record of the land, saying, Go up and down through the land, and make a record of it and come back here to me, and I will make the distribution for you here by the decision of the Lord in Shiloh.

verses.en: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
verses.pt: Foram, pois, aqueles homens e passaram pela terra, demarcando-a por cidades em sete partes em um livro, e voltaram a Josué ao acampamento em Siló.
verses.en_web: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.
verses.en_bbe: So the men went, travelling through the land, and made a record of it by towns in seven parts in a book, and came back to Joshua to the tent-circle at Shiloh.

verses.en: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.pt: E Josué lhes lançou as sortes diante do SENHOR em Siló; e ali repartiu Josué a terra aos filhos de Israel por suas porções.
verses.en_web: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.en_bbe: And Joshua made the distribution for them in Shiloh by the decision of the Lord, marking out the land for the children of Israel by their divisions.

verses.en: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.pt: E tirou-se a sorte da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim por suas famílias: e saiu o termo de sua porção entre os filhos de Judá e os filhos de José.
verses.en_web: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.en_bbe: And the first heritage came out for the tribe of Benjamin by their families: and the limit of their heritage went between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

verses.en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
verses.pt: E foi o termo deles ao lado do norte desde o Jordão: e sobe aquele termo ao lado de Jericó ao norte; sobe depois ao monte até o ocidente, e vem a sair ao deserto de Bete-Áven:
verses.en_web: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
verses.en_bbe: And their limit on the north was from the Jordan, and the line goes up to the side of Jericho on the north and through the hill-country to the west, ending at the waste land of Beth-aven.

verses.en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth-horon.
verses.pt: E dali passa aquele termo a Luz, pelo lado de Luz (esta é Betel) até o sul. E desce este termo de Atarote-Adar ao monte que está ao sul de Bete-Horom a de abaixo.
verses.en_web: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.
verses.en_bbe: And from there the line goes south to Luz, to the side of Luz (which is Beth-el), then down to Ataroth-addar, by the mountain to the south of Beth-horon the lower.

verses.en: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
verses.pt: E torna este termo, e dá volta ao lado do mar, ao sul até o monte que está diante de Bete-Horom ao sul; e vem a sair a Quriate-Baal, que é Quriate-Jearim, cidade dos filhos de Judá. Este é o lado do ocidente.
verses.en_web: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.
verses.en_bbe: And the limit is marked as coming round to the south on the west side from the mountain which is south of Beth-horon, and ending at Kiriath-baal (which is Kiriath-jearim), a town of the children of Judah: this is the west part.

verses.en: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
verses.pt: E o lado do sul é desde a extremidade de Quriate-Jearim, e sai o termo ao ocidente, e sai à fonte das águas de Neftoa:
verses.en_web: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
verses.en_bbe: And the south part is from the farthest point of Kiriath-jearim, and the line goes out to the west to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah:

verses.en: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to En-rogel,
verses.pt: E desce este termo ao fim do monte que está diante do vale do filho de Hinom, que está na campina dos gigantes até o norte: desce logo ao vale de Hinom, ao lado dos jebuseus ao sul, e dali desce à fonte de Rogel;
verses.en_web: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.
verses.en_bbe: And the line goes down to the farthest part of the mountain facing the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is on the north of the valley of Rephaim: from there it goes down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite on the south as far as En-rogel;

verses.en: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to En-shemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
verses.pt: E do norte torna e sai a En-Semes, e dali sai a Gelilote, que está diante da subida de Adumim, e descia à pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben:
verses.en_web: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is over against the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
verses.en_bbe: And it goes to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth, opposite the way up to Adummim, and it goes down to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben;

verses.en: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:
verses.pt: E passa ao lado que está diante da campina do norte, e desce às planícies:
verses.en_web: It passed along to the side over against the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.
verses.en_bbe: And it goes on to the side facing the Arabah to the north, and down to the Arabah;

verses.en: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
verses.pt: E torna a passar este termo pelo lado de Bete-Hogla até o norte, e vem a sair o termo à baía do mar Salgado ao norte, ao fim do Jordão ao sul. Este é o termo do sul.
verses.en_web: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.
verses.en_bbe: And on to the north side of Beth-hoglah, ending at the north inlet of the Salt Sea at the south end of Jordan; this is their limit on the south.

verses.en: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
verses.pt: E o Jordão acaba este termo ao lado do oriente. Esta é a herança dos filhos de Benjamim por seus termos ao redor, conforme suas famílias.
verses.en_web: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: And the limit of the east part is the Jordan. This is the heritage of the children of Benjamin, marked out for their families by these limits on all sides.

verses.en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
verses.pt: As cidades da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, por suas famílias, foram Jericó, Bete-Hogla, e Emeque-Queziz,
verses.en_web: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
verses.en_bbe: And the towns of the children of Benjamin, given to them in the order of their families, are Jericho and Beth-hoglah and Emek-kezziz

verses.en: And Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
verses.pt: Bete-Arabá, Zemaraim, e Betel;
verses.en_web: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
verses.en_bbe: And Beth-arabah and Zemaraim and Beth-el

verses.en: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
verses.pt: E Avim, e Pará, e Ofra,
verses.en_web: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
verses.en_bbe: And Avvim and Parah and Ophrah

verses.en: And Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
verses.pt: E Quefar-Amonai, Ofni, e Geba; doze cidades com suas aldeias:
verses.en_web: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.
verses.en_bbe: And Chephar-Ammoni and Ophni and Geba; twelve towns with their unwalled places;

verses.en: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
verses.pt: Gibeão, Ramá, Beerote,
verses.en_web: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
verses.en_bbe: Gibeon and Ramah and Beeroth

verses.en: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
verses.pt: E Mispá, Quefira, e Moza,
verses.en_web: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,
verses.en_bbe: And Mizpeh and Chephirah and Mozah

verses.en: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
verses.pt: Requém, Irpeel e Tarala,
verses.en_web: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
verses.en_bbe: And Rekem and Irpeel and Taralah

verses.en: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.pt: E Zela, Elefe, Jebus, que é Jerusalém, Gibeá, e Quiriate; catorze cidades com suas aldeias. Esta é a herança dos filhos de Benjamim, conforme suas famílias.
verses.en_web: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.en_bbe: And Zela, Eleph and the Jebusite (which is Jerusalem), Gibeath and Kiriath; fourteen towns with their unwalled places. This is the heritage of the children of Benjamin by their families.
